title: Assessment in accordance with the provisions of c. 375, § 3 of the Acts of 1981 (Section 12M of c. 25, G.L.) as amended by c. 233 of the Acts of 1983 (Section 17A of Chapter 25, G.L.) and as further amended by c. 516 of the Acts of 1987, the Commission of the Department of Public Utilities hereby makes an assessment on the Intra-state Revenues of Electric companies for the administration and operation of the Fuel Charge Monitoring Bureau.
